symbols: addEdgesToElkGraph measured label width and height

contracts.titleMeasurement: Explicit optional MeasuredTitle; title presence and complete finite nonnegative width/height/ascent/descent must match diagram title before worker allocation; height must contain actual ascent+descent; text_anchor must be start/middle/end, default middle
contracts.titlePlacement: After actual ELK result, exclude unpainted engine extent from content union. The source insertion point is center=content.x+content.width/2. CSS text-anchor sets box left: middle center-width/2, start center, end center-width. Top=-title_top_margin-ascent, retaining actual measured height. text-align is independent and does not set this anchor. Title is never an ELK node.
contracts.titleBounds: geometry_bounds includes optional final title box; include_engine=False returns pure content union, include_engine=True default preserves pre-F013 graph padding semantics; empty content union is a zero box.
contracts.richLabels: ELK consumes only actual measured label/node/group sizes, not native fonts/runs/HTML; valid sanitized empty or line-break-only edge label may have width0 with positive measured height.
contracts.shapeThemeConfig: Sole geometry.shapes provider receives config=diagram.config to match measured theme radius/look; no copied shape implementation.
contracts.nativeBoundary: No Canvas allocation, no fontsize guesses, no repeated engine layout for title, no fixed title coordinates or post-layout content translation. Engine width/height/nodes/edges/groups remain unchanged by title.
